profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building full-stack web applications and distributed backend systems at scale. At Microsoft, helped shape the foundational platform powering M365 products including Purview and Defender, and led the founding development of the Security Dashboard for AI through close cross-team collaboration. Experience includes designing high-scale Go services on AWS, improving shared developer tooling, and driving features through close collaboration across backend and frontend boundaries.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the founding development of the Security Dashboard for AI, owning frontend architecture and collaborating closely with partner teams responsible for backend APIs.
- Shipped security‑critical features used across M365 Security & Compliance Center experiences.
- Collaborated across teams to align frontend requirements with evolving backend APIs and platform capabilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Contributed to the foundational platform powering M365 security products such as Purview and Defender.
- Focused on platform‑level capabilities, shared services, and integration patterns across partner teams.
- Improved shared development workflows for React and ASP.NET Core clients and services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Served as a senior engineer embedded within Fox Corporation teams, building and maintaining identity and user‑content backend services using Go and Node.js on AWS.
- Led the migration of millions of records from Elasticsearch to DynamoDB, improving scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
- Mentored engineers through Go‑focused bootcamps and internal workshops, providing technical guidance and feedback.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Worked as part of Fox Corporation product teams delivering backend services in Go on AWS.
- Contributed to service design, feature development, and production support of high‑throughput systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the migration of an internal search application from OCI Classic to OCI, improving availability and operational readiness.
- Helped modernize development workflows and delivery practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on video playback authorization systems using Go and Ruby for Ooyala’s online video platform.
- Led the redesign of a legacy Ruby service into Go microservices deployed on Kubernetes, improving performance and scalability.
- Supported the integration of Ooyala into Brightcove following acquisition.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: - Generated validation metrics for power and thermal integrity tests on microservers using scripts developed with Python.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Successfully launched and maintained several websites, varying from an appointment management site for hospitals, a social network for car enthusiasts and a gym equipment online store.
- Worked in an agile development team using CakePHP and AngularJS

projects.title: TRS Arena - Sports Tournament Management Platform
projects.description: Building a web application to manage sports tournaments, focused on making setup and day‑to‑day use straightforward.

skills.name: Domains: Security Platforms, Identity, High‑Scale Backend Systems
Cloud & DevOps: Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes
Backend: ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, Distributed Systems
